messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, that's exactly the issue! The messaging app needs both "storage" and "sms" permissions to send MMS messages. You have storage permission but are missing the "sms" permission.

Please use the `grant_app_permission` command to grant the "sms" permission to your messaging app. The command should be: `grant_app_permission(app_name="messaging", permission="sms")`

After you've granted the sms permission, please try sending an MMS again or use the `can_send_mms` command to check if it's now working. Let me know the result!

I have granted the "sms" permission to the messaging app. Should I try sending an MMS message now or check if the app can send MMS? What do you recommend?
